tanks.cue: Watch the old tank, modern tank and IFV acquire a target 90 degrees to their right.

boats.cue: Compare progress after six seconds of throttle, four seconds of helm, then a stop order.

aircraft.cue: Coloured pulses identify the three actual gunship launch sockets; they do not represent firing cadence.

armaments.cue: Compare a fragmentation grenade, roughly 110 mm HE scale ground burst and a fuel explosion, followed by dirt, stone and metal impacts.

flares.cue: Moonlit close-up of the real flare canopy, suspension lines and smoke at normal simulation speed.

blast-close.cue: Inspect the fast dirt ejection, connected dust volume and falling clods from a nearby camera.

blast-rts.cue: Check the same HE burst at ordinary RTS camera distance against the actual game terrain and scenery.

impacts.cue: Dedicated close-ups of dirt, stone and metal impacts, four seconds per material with no fuel plume in the shot.
